data.name: Fathiyah
data.short_meaning: Opening, Opener, Opener of the Gate
data.long_meaning: Fathiyah is the name of the Surah (Chapter) 45 in the Holy Quran. It is a Meccan Surah which was revealed to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) in the early period of Islam. The name Fathiyah refers to opening, opening up, or opening the way to something. It is also used to describe someone who opens the way or clears the path for others.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the opening of the heart to faith and knowledge.
data.numerology_meaning: Expressive, creative, and socially gifted, 3s have a great ability to inspire others.

in_arabic.name: فاتحية
in_arabic.meaning: فاتحية تعني الفتح والنصر والتمكين من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاتحية مشتق من الفاتح، يعني الفتح والنصر والتمكين من الله. يرمز إلى فتح أبواب الخير والرزق والنجاح. يستخدم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كاسم للبنات، معبرًا عن الأمل والتفاؤل بالمستقبل.

in_urdu.name: فتحیا
in_urdu.meaning: فتحیا مطلب ہے فتح و نصرت اور اللہ کی قدرت
in_urdu.long_meaning: فتحیا نام فتح سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فتح و نصرت اور اللہ کی قدرت۔ یہ نام اچھے مستقبل اور کامیابی کی امید پر رکھا جاتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان اس کا اہم استعمال ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फातिहिया
in_hindi.meaning: फातिहिया का अर्थ है فتح और जीत और ईश्वर की शक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: फातिहिया नाम 'फातिह' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है فتح और जीत और ईश्वर की शक्ति। यह नाम अच्छे भविष्य और सफलता की आशा पर रखा जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका महत्वपूर्ण उपयोग है।

in_pashto.name: فتحيہ
in_pashto.meaning: فتحيہ معنی یې فتح او بریا او د الله قدرت
in_pashto.long_meaning: فتحيہ نوم د فتح څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې فتح او بریا او د الله قدرت. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې د نجونو لپاره کارول کیږي، د ښه راتلونکي او بریا هیله څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Fathiyah
in_english.meaning: Means 'opening, victory, and empowerment from God'
in_english.long_meaning: Fathiyah is derived from 'Fatih', meaning 'opening, victory, and empowerment from God'. It symbolizes the opening of doors to goodness, sustenance, and success. Used in many Islamic cultures as a name for girls, expressing hope and optimism for the future. Etymologically linked to the Arabic root 'F-T-H', which is mentioned in the Quran.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fathiyah holds great importance in Islamic culture, as it is the name of the Surah that Muslims recite at the beginning of every ritual prayer known as Salah. Thus, it symbolizes the beginning and the foundation of a devotional act that forms an integral part of their daily lives. Besides its significance during prayers, it is used in various sects of Sufism (Islamic mysticism) and as a name for girls in the Arab world.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Fathiyah signifies the opening or unveiling of the path to God. It is through the remembrance and recitation of the name and the verses of this Surah that Muslims seek to connect with God, and seek guidance and wisdom in their lives. The opening lines of Fathiyah are surrounded with great reverence as its rhythm and imagery remind Muslims of God's immense power, unity, and Creator-creation relationship. The name Fathiyah stands as a beautiful reminder of Allah's guidance, and the potential for spiritual growth that lies within each individual who seeks to surrender to Him.
